purpose: Complete a real data -> LoRA training -> own checkpoint -> simulation validation pilot for research internship preparation.
question: Can official pi05_base be LoRA trained on real Object demonstrations on the existing 3090, with verified frozen original weights, checkpoint reload, and paired closed-loop simulation?
success_criteria: All 50 expert episode files pass SHA256 and shape checks.
500 real optimizer updates complete with finite losses and gradients.
Step-0 and step-500 checkpoints save, reload, and each completes 10 simulator episodes.
not_promised: A positive task success rate or generalization improvement is not required to establish a working training pipeline.

model.trainable: Only parameter paths containing lora; all original weights frozen, including vision and projections.
model.normalization: train-only per-frame mean/std and exact q01/q99; raw actions already deltas; no extra delta conversion

training.frame_sampling: uniform over training frames with replacement
training.chunk_end_handling: repeat last action within each episode; never cross episode boundary

validation_loss.selection: predeclared final checkpoint only; no search by validation success

simulation.evaluator: pinned official evaluator; shift initial state index and add logging only

limitations: Pilot subset and 500 updates cannot reproduce a converged official expert.
Frozen bfloat16 original weights are checked before/after training, after initialization casts.
State index 1 is new relative to earlier runs, but demonstration collection state disjointness has not been audited.
Uniform frame sampling gives longer episodes more weight.
Raw Parquet reader reuses official OpenPI transforms and official training functions; not the stock LeRobot loader.
